questions.stem: What are plasmids and why are they important?

options.text: Small circular rings of extra DNA that can carry antibiotic resistance genes
Protein structures that help bacteria move through liquid
The main circular chromosome found in all cells
Large organelles that carry out respiration in bacteria

questions.explanation: Plasmids are small, circular pieces of DNA separate from the main bacterial chromosome. They often carry genes for antibiotic resistance and can be transferred between bacteria, which is why they are also important in genetic engineering.
